error_reason: The agent erroneously assumed the 'optimal strategy' required knowing the hidden coin distribution to guess exact numbers. This is impossible as the distribution is hidden; the optimal strategy must be a fixed set of guesses that guarantees a minimum win against any valid distribution (where one box has x, one x+6, and one y >= 2), which the agent failed to derive.

hypotheses.rationale: The agent incorrectly assumed Bob can know the exact distribution of coins before guessing. The problem asks for the minimum amount Bob can win using an optimal strategy against a hidden distribution chosen by the host. The agent's solution (guessing exact numbers) only works if Bob knows the specific distribution (e.g., that it is 6, 12, 12), which is impossible as the coins are shuffled and hidden. The agent failed to identify that the 'optimal strategy' must be a fixed set of guesses that guarantees a minimum return regardless of which of the valid distributions is actually chosen.
hypotheses.check: Verify if the agent considered the worst-case scenario across all valid distributions (6,12,12), (7,10,13), and (8,8,14) assuming Bob has no prior knowledge of which specific distribution is active. Specifically, check if the agent calculated the maximum of the minimums (maximin) rather than assuming the best case (guessing correctly).
